name: atelier
label: Atelier
description: Dark-first aesthetic layer: warm neutral surfaces that lighten step by step, text hierarchy by tone, the brand colour kept for the main action and the selected state, surfaces lit by an inset sheen, a display face for headings and labels. Light mode included. Works with shadcn/ui and shadcn-vue components through the same alias layer as the shadcn preset.

upstream.project: Atelier design system (portfolio design system of the kit author)

values.source: design-system/tokens/tokens.json and STYLEGUIDE.md of the author's portfolio design system (private repository), contributed by the author under MIT
values.verify: Neutral steps 300 and 700 are interpolated between the source steps. The source has no warning or info role: warning uses the source orange, info the kit default. Line heights are rounded to whole px; the subtitle and body line heights are opened up for UI text.

taken: Warm neutral palette and how surfaces step from canvas to raised in dark and light
Brand used only for the main action, accents and the selected state (text, stroke, tint)
Inset sheen shadows for dark surfaces, soft drop shadows for light, the brand glow on the primary button, hover ring
Radius scale (sm 4 to 3xl 20) and type scale (32 display to 13 label), display face for headings and labels
Motion: 200 to 400 ms with a non-bouncing ease-out
Component recipes: glass secondary button, raised inputs with a focus ring, dashed list separators, gold selected state
not_taken: No source code, no React components, no decorative components (globe, particles, cursor, bookshelf)
No logos, images, brand names or personal content from the portfolio
No breakpoints from the source (Framer frame sizes); the kit's Material Design 3 window size classes apply
No web font files; the profile names font families only

structure.source: Material Design 3 guidelines (published layout and component guidance; no assets, icons or fonts)
taken: Window size classes: compact < 600, medium 600-839, expanded >= 840
Bottom sheet, navigation bar (bottom tab bar), navigation rail, FAB, top app bar, segmented button, chips, snackbar placement, list row heights

contrast_skip.bg-brand on bg-canvas: replaced by stroke-brand on bg-canvas: brand fills carry a stroke-brand border that meets 3:1 (WCAG 1.4.11), so a pale brand colour keeps its tone
contrast_skip.bg-brand on bg-brand-subtle: replaced by stroke-brand on bg-canvas: brand fills carry a stroke-brand border that meets 3:1 (WCAG 1.4.11), so a pale brand colour keeps its tone

semantic_note: Brand fills (primary button, filled icon button, FAB, checked checkbox, radio and switch) always draw a stroke-brand border.
